rationale: The plan correctly treats the balanced batch as a covariate in ~ batch + condition on raw counts with control releveled as reference, and it explicitly forbids pre-normalization and dropping the batch term, so the design and formula criteria are well met. QC includes PCA/sample distances colored by both batch and condition but omits library-size checks and any stated policy for outlier or shallow samples. Fold-change shrinkage is only implied by listing apeglm in packages and is never stated in the acceptance criteria, and the effect-size ranking of top genes is not tied to shrunken estimates. Enrichment is added though the question only asks which genes differ; the collection and version are named and a ranking metric is loosely given, but no ORA universe or gene-set size window is specified. The report names the method, design, threshold, and power caveat but not package versions or an explicit tested-gene count.
